description: Use this to list a group's expenses and payments, newest first, optionally filtered by date range, category or participant token. Page with cursor.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

categoryToken.description: Only transactions filed under this group category.

cursor.description: The `pagination.cursor` of the previous page. Opaque; pass it back unchanged.

from.description: Only transactions dated on or after this date.

participantToken.description: Only transactions this participant paid for or owes a share of.

to.description: Only transactions dated on or before this date.

name: list_transactions
title: List expenses
